title: research.radar.item v1
description: Emitted by adapters/frontier-radar when a new real-world event (one primary artifact: canonical URL, GitHub owner/repo@tag, arXiv id or HF model id) is first stored (stage=new) or after typed triage (stage=triaged). Notification only: ids and the minimal facts needed to decide whether to fetch. Public sources only.

event_key.description: Dedup key of the primary artifact, e.g. gh:owner/repo@tag, arxiv:2611.01234, hf:org/model, or the canonical URL.

stage.description: new = first stored by poll; triaged = classified by the triage command.

source_id.description: Registry id (sources.toml) of the source that supplied the primary sighting.

domains.description: Domains from the registry for the sources that saw the event.

mirror_count.description: Sightings tagged as mirrors, bots or press bridges of the primary.

score.description: Deterministic score at emit time. Provisional until the T+72h engagement snapshot exists.
